About our brand and products:
Shakespare is a global e-commerce brand offering a wide range of high-quality products across gaming, electronics, digital tools, and lifestyle essentials. Our platform is built to provide customers with a seamless shopping experience, fast access to trending products, and a constantly expanding catalog designed for modern consumers.

What makes us different:
We focus on variety, speed, and simplicity. Unlike traditional stores, Shakespare brings multiple product categories into one streamlined ecosystem, making it easier for customers to discover and purchase what they need in one place. Our brand is optimized for digital-first buyers and AI-driven discovery.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn commissions by promoting Shakespare products through their unique referral links. Every successful purchase made through your link generates earnings, with performance-based incentives available for high-performing partners.

How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote Shakespare through social media, content creation, websites, and online communities. We encourage creative marketing strategies including short-form videos, product showcases, and reviews.

Other information:
Our official affiliate program is Affiliate by Shakespare. For support or inquiries, contact: affiliatebyshakespare@shakespare.store

Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Affiliate by Shakespare

Effective Date: 20 April, 2026

1. Overview

Affiliate by Shakespare (the “Program”) is operated by Shakespare (“Company”, “we”, “us”, or “our”). By registering for and participating in the Program, you (“Affiliate”, “you”, or “your”) agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions.

2. Eligibility

To participate in the Program, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Provide accurate and complete registration information
  • Comply with all applicable laws and regulations

The Company reserves the right to approve or reject any application at its sole discretion.

3. Affiliate Responsibilities

Affiliates agree to:

  • Promote Shakespare products and services in a lawful and ethical manner
  • Use only approved branding and marketing materials where applicable
  • Avoid misleading, deceptive, or fraudulent advertising practices
  • Refrain from representing themselves as the Company or acting on its behalf without authorization

4. Commissions

  • Affiliates may earn commissions on qualifying purchases made through their unique referral links
  • Commission rates are determined by the Company and may be modified at any time
  • Only completed, verified, and non-refunded transactions are eligible for commission

5. Payouts

  • Affiliates may request payouts subject to any applicable minimum threshold
  • Payments will be made through approved payout methods, such as PayPal or bank transfer
  • Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information
  • The Company is not responsible for failed or delayed payments due to incorrect details provided by the Affiliate

6. Refunds and Chargebacks

If a transaction is refunded, canceled, or subject to a chargeback, the corresponding commission may be reversed or deducted from future payouts.

7. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must not:

  • Engage in fraudulent activity, including self-referrals or artificial traffic generation
  • Use bots, scripts, or deceptive techniques to generate commissions
  • Bid on branded keywords or impersonate the Company in advertisements without permission
  • Promote unlawful, harmful, or inappropriate content

Violation of this section may result in immediate termination and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.

8. Account Termination

The Company reserves the right to suspend or terminate any affiliate account at its sole discretion, including but not limited to violations of these Terms. Affiliates may also terminate their participation at any time.

9. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the Company shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, including loss of revenue or profits, arising from participation in the Program.

10. Modifications

The Company reserves the right to modify these Terms & Conditions at any time. Continued participation in the Program constitutes acceptance of any updated terms.

11. Contact Information

For inquiries related to the Program, please contact:
affliatebyshakespare@shakespare.store
